fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Provider
fields.description: Login verification also requires WhatsApp selected in System Settings and a verified, enabled User.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: WhatsApp messages are delivered through the selected WA Chat Hub provider.

fields.label: Sending Account
fields.description: Select an active Interakt account. Its API credentials are managed in Chat Channel Account.

fields.label: Authentication Template Name
fields.description: Exact provider template name, not its display label. Use an approved Authentication template with one code variable.

fields.label: Template Language Code
fields.description: Use the language code approved for this template, for example en. It must match the provider template.

fields.label: Login Code Expiry (seconds)
fields.description: 60-600 seconds. Validity of each login code; resends are capped by the total login time limit.

fields.label: Login Sends per User per Hour
fields.description: 1-100 per user. Counts the initial login code and resends together; separate from enrollment sends. This is not the provider account-wide API limit.

fields.label: Total Login Time Limit (seconds)
fields.description: 60-3600 seconds. Total time allowed from the first login send, including resends. Must be at least Login Code Expiry.

fields.label: Enrollment Code Expiry (seconds)
fields.description: 60-600 seconds. Time to verify ownership of the saved User number before enabling WhatsApp 2FA.

fields.label: Enrollment Sends per User per Hour
fields.description: 1-100 per user. Counts enrollment sends and resends; separate from login sends.

fields.label: Incorrect Enrollment Attempts per Code
fields.description: 1-10 incorrect entries per enrollment code. After this limit, request a new code. Login attempts use Frappe login controls.

fields.label: Resend Cooldown (seconds)
fields.description: 10-3600 seconds, but shorter than both code expiry times. Shared setting for login and enrollment resend buttons.

fields.label: Keep Audit Logs For (days)
fields.description: 1-365 days. Daily cleanup deletes older audit records. The scheduler and worker must be running.
